name: NayaPOWER GitHub Optimization Gate
purpose: Make GitHub a clean, coherent, machine-checkable operating environment rather than a pile of competing instructions.
failure_policy: The gate fails closed. A passing gate means the repository structure is internally classifiable; it does not by itself prove a live runtime is correct.

delete_only_when: artifact is demonstrably obsolete, retired, disabled, duplicate, superseded, or orphaned
current authority and dependency checks show no unique active role
replacement or surviving canonical source is identified when applicable
deletion preserves current functionality and Git history remains available
preserve_when: artifact is a fail-closed boundary that prevents an unsafe authority substitution
artifact contains unique historical intelligence not safely represented elsewhere
never: delete merely because a filename is old
delete current NIS/canonical intelligence without direct evidence
delete the current 509 boundary merely to reduce file count
erase historical truth to make the repository look cleaner

current_cleanup_result.reason: Ten workflows were explicitly DISABLED/RETIRED and each identified a newer/canonical replacement. The preserved world-class workflow is a live fail-closed boundary and therefore remains useful until Assistant-lane authority is resolved.

next_action: Independently adjudicate the first-pass classification (Oscar, Builder != Judge); apply status labels to the 61 live GitHub issues via an authenticated surface; then bind Smart Notes to Sessions/Activities and build the temporal day/project retrieval index, proving cold-Naya acceptance behaviorally on CI.

authority_resolutions.resolution: .naya/activity = COMPATIBILITY_ARCHIVE (index L121 classification task); SUPERBRAIN/NAYA-ACTIVITY first-class projection.
assistant-cloudflare-hub-release.yml = sole production deployment authority (human authority, commits 6780aabf/3cfa3f76).

gate_evaluation.failure_policy_note: Structural GREEN per declared policy: repository is internally classifiable; it does not by itself prove a live runtime is correct. Runtime/live proof remains workflow-gated.
gate_evaluation.builder_vs_judge: Classification first pass is Builder-produced; independent Oscar review is the recorded next action.
